test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Sept 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Meena, Saroj, Goldy, Priti, Poonam and Baby are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

Meena sits to the immediate left of Saroj. Goldy sits 3rd to the right of Saroj. Priti sits 2nd to the left of Goldy. Poonam sits to the immediate right of Goldy.

Who sits 2nd to the left of Baby?
solution: **Given:** Meena, Saroj, Goldy, Priti, Poonam and Baby are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. 1) Meena sits to the immediate left of Saroj. 2) Goldy sits 3rd to the right of Saroj.
